result.reason: The redline reaches an acceptable playbook position: Customer retains the one-month notice right, early-termination charges are capped at three months’ recurring charges, and prepaid post-termination charges are refunded. It does not introduce a Vendor convenience-termination right. The changes are substantively limited and preserve the existing attachment structure and prerequisite exception. Drafting is generally clear, though placing IBM’s refund obligation within item (b) after the introductory phrase “Customer may terminate ... by” creates a minor grammatical awkwardness; the refund should ideally be stated in a separate sentence or subsection.
